occurrences.text: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.
Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
